correctness.rationale: For the folded five-cube, five direction masks have one total zero relation, and any four are independent. Direction-permutation and translation symmetries reduce all independent triples to {0,3,5}. Its only independent extensions are {6,9,14}, yielding 80 independent pairs,160 independent triples,120 independent quadruples,16 five-sets and exactly 56 maximal independent concepts. The two four-set orbit representatives are shattered by the explicit 16-trace witness table; all smaller independent faces inherit shattering. Edges cannot be all-positive and the unique five-set completion prevents a 4-positive/1-negative trace, excluding every other support. Two independently constructed exhaustive verifiers (4-bit XOR model and 5-bit antipodal quotient model) enumerate all 65536 supports per graph and agree on the polynomial and Q4 contrast. Source code and exact commands provided.

originality.rationale: The new statement determines the complete trace-shattering complex of inclusion-maximal independent vertex sets for the folded five-cube and explains an edge-insertion purity reversal with two exact facet orbits. Kahn–Park determines asymptotic MIS counts for Hamming cubes, not membership traces. Krivelevich et al. treats random-greedy independent sets and local limits, not shattering. Benediktsson–Macpherson–Adler treats open-neighborhood relations on Johnson/Hamming graphs, not MIS concepts. The traditional Clebsch graph reference supplies the graph and symmetry, not any trace polynomial. Related published results on the folded-cube ordinary independence complex concern topology of ordinary independent sets rather than shattering by their maximal faces. An earlier unindexed exact finite table or overlooked mathematical equivalence remains possible, and search absence does not prove novelty.

value.rationale: The natural invariant is the full vertex-membership shattering complex of all maximal independent sets of a canonical highly symmetric graph and its geometric antipodal perturbation. It exhibits a substantive separation between ordinary independence-complex purity and shattering purity: a graph with maximal independent sets of sizes 4 and 5 nevertheless has a pure 120-facet shattering complex. Inserting eight edges removes all eight lower-dimensional facets of Q4 while adding 16 top faces, a nonmonotone structural phenomenon not visible from scalar VC dimension, degrees, or standard independent-set counts. Exact classification by two geometric symmetry orbits gives interpretable and reusable witnesses rather than only a table.
